value.rationale: The paper highlights degree as the solution count governing minimal problems and explicitly notes the exceptional degrees five, four, and three line-degree strata. Identifying the precise Hilbert flat limits explains those jumps geometrically: the actual special fibers stay smooth while a fixed base-locus plane is lost. This is a structural boundary statement about the distortion construction, not a recomputation of the published degrees, and supplies a concrete template for flattening more general distortion families.
